name: rungstone
description: Offline, read-only toolkit for controls engineers: understand, translate, verify and dependency-map PLC code across Rockwell, Siemens, CODESYS and Beckhoff; extend to HMI/SCADA screens, tags and alarms; troubleshoot stops from exported historian data. Safety-rated logic is always excluded; simulation results are labelled simulated, not hardware-tested.

historian_config.title: Historian connector config (optional)
historian_config.description: Leave empty to keep the read-only historian connector off. Only set this after plant IT/OT approval: a JSON config with "enabled": true and a sqlite, csv_dir, odbc or opcua backend (see mcp/historian/README.md).

odbc_connection.title: ODBC connection string (optional)
odbc_connection.description: For the odbc backend only. Use a read-only database account. Stored in your secure credential store and given only to the Rungstone historian connector.

opcua_username.title: OPC UA username (optional)
opcua_username.description: For the opcua backend only. Leave empty for an anonymous session. Use an account with read-only rights.

opcua_password.title: OPC UA password (optional)
opcua_password.description: For the opcua backend only. Stored in your secure credential store and given only to the Rungstone historian connector.
